items.title: Gates open at 6 pm
items.message: The main gate opens at 6 pm for all registered participants. Please keep your pass ready.

items.title: Parking moved to Lot B
items.message: Lot A is closed for maintenance. Use Lot B on the east side this weekend.

items.title: Volunteer briefing at 4 pm
items.message: All volunteers please gather at the help desk for a short briefing before the gates open.

items.title: Lost and found desk
items.message: Lost items can be collected from the help desk near Gate 2.
